about: Labelled cases for the advancement judge (pulpermill/prompter/mill/advance.py). Rewords and same_kind cases come from the first test story; genuine moves are hand-written. Names are placeholders for the story's cards. The chain's first aim (bake sun loaves) is the chapter-1 baseline, so it is listed as new_kind; the other three aims from the story are same_kind against the chain before them.
